name: asc-payout
description: Ask what Apple will pay you: earnings per fiscal month, history, subscriptions and MRR, refunds and cancellations, and profit after Apple Ads, from your own App Store Connect data.
long_description:
Answers App Store earnings questions with the asc-payout program installed on this computer, using the accounts you set up with `asc-payout setup`. Runs locally: your API keys never leave your computer, only the results reach the conversation.

Needs asc-payout installed and an account set up. See https://github.com/erenacarboga/asc-payout

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: The App Store Connect accounts set up in asc-payout and the display currency

tools.name: get_month
tools.description: What Apple pays for a fiscal month: payment, Financial Report, Trends, apps, countries

tools.name: get_history
tools.description: Payments month by month, or the months of a year

tools.name: get_subscriptions
tools.description: Paying subscribers, trials, billing problems and MRR per app, and recent events

tools.name: get_refunds_and_cancellations
tools.description: Trials and conversions, cancellations and why, refunds, payment problems

tools.name: get_profit
tools.description: Revenue next to Apple Ads spend: profit, ROAS, installs, cost per install

asc_payout_path.title: asc-payout program (optional)
asc_payout_path.description: Only if asc-payout is installed somewhere unusual. By default the extension finds it where the installer puts it, or on PATH.
